sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for your offer and the visibility into your underlying costs; we appreciate your support and look forward to continuing our cooperation. Please share your cost calculation in XLSX format so we can review its components together. We would also be open to discussing a longer-term volume agreement and the improved pricing and payment terms it could support.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Producer prices DE: bearings, gears, gearing and driving elements changed +0.6% from 2026-02 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2815@2026-02, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08). Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +1.7% from 2025-12 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06). Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.79, payment_days 14, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.84, payment_days 60, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.81, payment_days 30, contract_months 36). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. That does not change our position. 

Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will address your inquiry regarding the cost breakdown separately. 

We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month volume agreement and have adjusted our proposal to reflect this extended term. Our updated offer stands at a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Building on your requested 30-day payment period, we can offer a revised price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Please note that our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for adjusting your proposal to reflect the extended volume agreement and for offering a payment-term option. We appreciate your colleagues following up on the cost breakdown; please ask them to provide the shareable calculation in XLSX format so we can review its elements alongside the proposed terms.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.88, payment_days 90, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.8, payment_days 14, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.85, payment_days 60, contract_months 36). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Building on your proposal for shorter payment terms, we can offer a unit price of €4.87 with a 14-day payment period for the 36-month contract. This represents our most competitive pricing for this volume and term. 

Please note that as a matter of company policy, we do not share detailed internal cost calculations or provide them in XLSX format. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Please also keep in mind that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We truly value our relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and look forward to continuing our cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for revising your offer and clearly setting out how payment terms affect your pricing. We respect your policy on sharing internal cost calculations and suggest keeping the renewal discussion focused on payment terms and pricing within the proposed contract framework, with a view to continuing our cooperation.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.84, payment_days 45, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.89, payment_days 90, contract_months 36; unit_price 4.81, payment_days 14, contract_months 36). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your focus on payment terms and pricing within the proposed contract framework. It is always a pleasure working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we are keen to keep supporting your requirements with our reliable service and broad product range.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer provides a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Building on your proposal for 45-day payment terms, we can offer a unit price of €4.89 for the 36-month contract. This package includes a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This represents our most competitive pricing for these terms. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
